title: Helal, M. H. et al. The Effectiveness of Hyaluronic Acid on Prefabricated CAD CAM Bone Blocks for Ridge Augmentation: A Split Mouth Study
authors: Helal, M.H., Sheta, M.S., Alsherif, A.A., Hassan, M.A., Aboushelib, M.N. and Ghouraba, R.F. (2025), The Effectiveness of Hyaluronic Acid on Prefabricated CAD CAM Bone Blocks for Ridge Augmentation: A Split Mouth Study. Clin Implant Dent Relat Res, 27: e70035.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss permamem (dense PTFE) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Within the limitations of this study, the addition of HA 8 to prefabricated CAD -CAM allogenic block enhanced its osteogenic properties and guaranteed adequate integration of the graft for implant insertion” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
